rules: Retain all tied holders and game source links.
Do not infer individual appearances or stats in the four owner-confirmed untracked Summer 2013 games.
Goalie save percentages, shots and minutes-based GAA are deferred until source quality and qualifying workloads are established.
Player scoring/attendance streaks and call-up/full-time records require complete participation and historical status data.
Playoff streaks and game-count records require explicit treatment of standalone overtime/shootout entries.
Current-season achievements remain provisional; COVID-shortened seasons retain their context.

candidates.label: Most team goals in a game
candidates.definition: Published final team score; excludes administrative defaults and possible standalone deciding entries.
candidates.qualification: Based on published recorded data; missing historical stats can conceal ties or a higher performance.

candidates.label: Largest winning margin
candidates.definition: Final GF minus GA for a played win; no default wins.

candidates.label: Largest losing margin

candidates.label: Most combined goals in a game
